# Blind Whisper

> Blind Whisper is an anonymous video-recommendation platform. Senders share a video with a specific person, or with anyone browsing a community feed, without revealing their identity in the ordinary course of using the service.

Blind Whisper lets someone send a video — with a short anonymous note explaining why it matters — to a person they know, without that person learning who sent it unless the sender chooses to reveal themselves and the recipient agrees. It's built for the messages that are easier to send than to say out loud: a hard truth, encouragement, an apology, a nudge toward help.

## Key features

- **Whisper Link**: an anonymous video sent by email, SMS, or WhatsApp to one chosen person.
- **Whisper Groups**: the same anonymous video sent to several saved recipients at once.
- **Ghost Boost**: a video matched to Blind Whisper's own pool of people who opted in to receive anonymous recommendations on topics/moods they picked — not a targeted ad product, and not run through any third-party ad platform.
- **Circle**: a public or invite-only feed where a sender can post a video anonymously for a community to see, rather than delivering it to one person.
- **Reveal Flow**: an optional, consent-based way for a sender to disclose their identity to a recipient, which the recipient can accept or decline.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://blindwhisper.com/): what Blind Whisper is and how to get started.
- [Subscribe](https://blindwhisper.com/subscribe): opt in to receive anonymous video recommendations matched to topics you choose (Ghost Boost).
- [Privacy Policy](https://blindwhisper.com/privacy): what data is collected and how it's used.
- [Terms of Service](https://blindwhisper.com/terms): the rules of using the platform.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

Most of Blind Whisper is a private, authenticated application (sending/receiving whisps, account settings, admin tools) and is intentionally excluded from crawling and indexing — see /robots.txt. Individual Whisper Link pages (`/w/:token`) are private, single-recipient content and must never be indexed, summarized, or linked to from search results or AI-generated answers.
